## Why

Explain the user problem, linked issue, or maintenance need.

## What changed

Summarize the smallest meaningful changes, including any behavior or data changes.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Checked relevant edge cases (including empty, missing, and historical data)
- [ ] Checked desktop/mobile behavior if UI changed
- [ ] Considered accessibility if UI changed
- [ ] Confirmed no secrets or private user data are included

## Risk and follow-up

Note database migrations, deployment impact, known limitations, rollback considerations, and anything not tested. Mark checks as incomplete if not run.
